title: Pilgrimage and transmission
shortSummary: Pilgrimage became durable knowledge transmission through translation, cataloguing, teaching and institutional collaboration.
curatorialDescription: The concept separates legendary travel into route evidence, text versions, language labour and urban institutions.
researchNote: Itineraries, stops and translation projects must be verified per figure rather than collapsed into one standard Silk Road.
